title: Benedicta es (Mouton)
desc: Jean Mouton, Benedicta es, 1514. 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
cr: From CRIM, Citations: The Renaissance Imitation Mass (crimproject.org, CRIM_Model_0021); edited by Vincent Besson, Richard Freedman. Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0.
